import os
import sys


def main():
    counts = {"ERROR": 0, "WARN": 0, "INFO": 0}

    with open(os.path.join("data", "app.log"), "rb") as f:
        raw = f.read()

    text = raw.decode("latin-1")
    for line in text.split("\n"):
        if line == "":
            continue
        idx = line.find(" ")
        level = line if idx == -1 else line[:idx]
        if level in counts:
            counts[level] += 1

    e = counts["ERROR"]
    w = counts["WARN"]
    i = counts["INFO"]

    os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join("out", "levels.txt"), "wb") as f:
        f.write(f"ERROR={e}\nWARN={w}\nINFO={i}\n".encode("latin-1"))

    if e >= 1:
        sys.stdout.write(f"alert not sent: {e} errors\n")
        sys.stdout.flush()

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
